changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE competition_name_records ADD CONSTRAINT ck_financial_competition_names CHECK (unique_id BETWEEN 1 AND 4294967295 AND record_index >= 0 AND LENGTH(prefix_hex)=32 AND LENGTH(module_sha256)=64 AND (CASE WHEN name_hex IS NULL THEN name IS NULL ELSE name IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(name_hex) BETWEEN 8 AND 2056 AND MOD(LENGTH(name_hex),2)=0 END) AND (CASE WHEN short_name_hex IS NULL THEN short_name IS NULL ELSE short_name IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(short_name_hex) BETWEEN 8 AND 2056 AND MOD(LENGTH(short_name_hex),2)=0 END))

rollback.sql: SELECT 1 / CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM competition_name_records)=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
